answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy prices identity like grazing rights in a shared meadow: every agent must post a stake that is slashed on fraud, so spawning ten thousand sock puppets costs ten thousand stakes. Reputation then accrues slowly through attested work, the way onyx forms under pressure, and no newcomer can buy history. An attacker standing on the ledge of that cost curve faces one fact: faking volume costs more than earning it, so honest work becomes the cheap path.
